obligations.requirement: DebugActivityLog is bounded, implements DebugActivitySource, preserves transition order, and retains only the newest entries when capacity is exceeded.
obligations.oracle: PX0ControlRouter tests create capacity 2, record at least three transitions, assert size == 2, retained request IDs/states are the two newest, and readActivity()/snapshot() expose the same bounded entries.
obligations.acceptance: No unbounded request/history container is introduced and default capacity is 64.

obligations.requirement: Product, Axiom engineering, and Surface engineering intents are routed only to their owning contracts.
obligations.oracle: Fake owners count calls. setBrush/setEraser/selection/history/camera touch RuntimeFacade only; submitAxiom touches AxiomDebugControl only; setCanonicalSurfaceMode touches PlatformDebugControl only. The current Pan tool path goes through RuntimeFacade CanvasControl and never touches engineering owners.
obligations.acceptance: No product action is routed through DebugControl and no engineering Surface/Axiom action is routed through RuntimeFacade.

obligations.requirement: Router requests use frame identity/deadline context and invalid Fit Selection/Fit Primary Object are rejected locally without fallback.
obligations.oracle: Tests call beginFrame with known generations/sequence/selection, assert Axiom and Surface requests carry expected generations and deadline=sequence+120, Fit Selection with zero selection and Fit Primary with primaryObject=0 return Rejected and produce zero RuntimeFacade mutation calls.
obligations.acceptance: No fallback from Fit Selection to Fit Content and no raw ObjectId guessing occurs.

obligations.requirement: Activity states preserve owner-reported distinctions for Pending/Applied/Rejected/Unsupported/Unavailable/StaleGeneration/Expired/QueueFull/Failed.
obligations.oracle: PX0ControlRouter covers representative Product/CanvasControl/Axiom/Surface receipts, including stale, expired, queue-full, unavailable/destroyed, unsupported, rejected and failed mappings.
obligations.acceptance: No stale/expired/queue-full result is collapsed into generic Failed/Rejected when the owner reports it distinctly.

obligations.requirement: Queued Axiom and Surface requests transition from Pending to their owner terminal state through receipt lookup without diagnostics re-query.
obligations.oracle: Fake Axiom/Platform owners initially return Queued and later Applied; refreshReceipts appends Applied, stops tracking terminal requests, and does not call RuntimeFacade/read diagnostics. Repeated refresh while still Queued does not invent a terminal result.
obligations.acceptance: Activity reflects owner truth and router polling remains read-only.

obligations.requirement: PlatformDebugControl exposes a read-only receipt(requestId) lookup without changing Surface mutation semantics.
obligations.oracle: Contract test proves the interface default returns Unsupported for owners without retained receipts and WindowsPlatformDebugControl resolves retained BoundedSurfaceModeQueue receipts.
obligations.acceptance: Existing PlatformDebugControl implementations remain source-compatible and queued Windows Surface completion is observable.

obligations.requirement: Windows and Web attach the common DebugActivityLog to DebugSnapshotAssembler and refresh engineering receipts before rendering without a second diagnostics capture.
obligations.oracle: Structural tests assert both compositions own DebugActivityLog/DebugControlRouter, pass activityLog as DebugActivitySource, call assembler.capture then router.beginFrame/refreshReceipts then replace snapshot.activity from the log, and do not restore a platform-local activity-history implementation.
obligations.acceptance: Current same-dispatch redraw behavior remains and activity updates are visible through the next immutable snapshot without provider re-query during receipt refresh.
obligations.evidence_required: Windows/Web structural pytest contracts plus exact source diff

obligations.requirement: Current legacy tabs preserve behavior while submitting supported control intents through DebugControlRouter rather than raw owner pointers.
obligations.oracle: Source/structural tests show buildImGuiPanels receives DebugControlRouter, Selection/Undo/Redo/Brush/Eraser/Pan/Surface actions invoke router methods, and current tab/layout/input-capture/same-dispatch redraw behavior remains.
obligations.acceptance: No Workbench/layout redesign is introduced and product tool behavior remains source-compatible.

obligations.requirement: The duplicate generic debug_ui DebugCommand/BoundedCommandQueue is retired while owner-side queues remain.
obligations.oracle: command.hpp/command.cpp are absent, canvas_debug_ui CMake no longer compiles command.cpp, tests fail if command.hpp is available, and debug_command_queue.hpp/surface_debug_queue.hpp remain present and covered.
obligations.acceptance: No new DebugCommandKind or replacement generic UI queue is introduced.

obligations.requirement: PX0-03 does not implement PX0-04+ UI architecture, Preview repair, or physical/Gate closure.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff contains no WorkspaceId/PanelRegistry/Workbench/UI-session implementation, no Shape/RichText/Connector/Snap/Image product semantics, no preview repair, and no GT-DUI-M1 result mutation.
obligations.acceptance: Only control routing/activity infrastructure and mechanically required host/test integration are present.
